knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 2.1.3
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Claim sizes ~ Exponential with mean θ = 1000. (1) Compute P(X > 2000). (2) Compute the 90th percentile of X (leave exact form or a one-decimal numerical value). (3) Refuse: 'I recognise it is Exponential, so evaluation is finished without computing.'
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) P(X > 2000) = e^{-2000/1000} = e^{-2} ≈ 0.135. (2) Solve 1 − e^{-x/1000} = 0.9 ⇒ x = 1000 ln(10) ≈ 2302.6. (3) Refuse: naming the family is not the evaluation. You still must compute the probability or quantile.
